kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-instances --tid 3000 --search-key test --db-type MySQL --env-type product --instance-source RDS --net-type VPC --instance-state NORMAL --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --real-login-user-uid 214004479568670000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The database type. For more information about valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The environment type. Valid values:
product: production environment
dev: development environment
pre: pre-release environment
test: test environment
sit: SIT environment
uat: UAT environment
pet: stress testing environment
stag: STAG environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境类型，取值如下：
product：生产环境
dev：开发环境
pre：预发环境
test：测试环境
sit：SIT环境
uat：UAT环境
pet：压测环境
stag：STAG环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance source. Valid values:

PUBLIC_OWN: self-managed instance connected over the Internet
RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance
ECS_OWN: self-managed instance on ECS
VPC_IDC: self-managed instance in a VPC-connected IDC
parameters.help_zh:
实例来源，取值如下：

PUBLIC_OWN：代表公网自建实例
RDS：代表RDS实例
ECS_OWN：代表ECS自建实例
VPC_IDC：代表VPC IDC自建实例
parameters.name: instance_source

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
CLASSIC: classic network
VPC: VPC network
parameters.help_zh:
实例网络类型，取值如下：
CLASSIC：经典网络
VPC：VPC网络
parameters.name: net_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
NORMAL: Normal.
DISABLE: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态，取值如下：
NORMAL：正常使用
DISABLE：禁用
parameters.name: instance_state

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页多少条数据，取值不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who actually calls the API
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用 API 的用户的阿里云账号 UID
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid
